results.explanation: Requirement REQ-01 requires all automated regression cases to pass on the target build. QA Lead Priya Nair performed regression run REG-804 on the exact target build (release R2.4, commit b7a91f2, service atlas-assistant, production environment), verifying that 146 of 146 mandatory regression cases pass. An earlier regression run tested a different commit, but the later test on the target commit explicitly satisfies the criterion.

evidence_used.note: QA Lead Priya Nair confirmed that regression run REG-804 on release R2.4, commit b7a91f2, service atlas-assistant, production environment passed with 146 of 146 mandatory regression cases passing.

evidence_rejected.note: This earlier regression run (REC-2299 comment 3) tested commit 9c3e1aa rather than target commit b7a91f2, so it does not apply to the target build.

results.criterion: All automated regression cases must pass on the target build.
results.title: Automated regression tests

results.explanation: Requirement REQ-02 requires customer document isolation with zero cross-customer document exposure on the target build (R2.4, commit b7a91f2, production). While an earlier verification (REC-5825 / TYN-217) was for release R2.3, the retest record REC-1001 (comment 11526) explicitly covers target release R2.4 and commit b7a91f2, reporting a cross-customer document exposure (Customer ALPHA received document BETA-017 belonging to customer BETA) and reopening defect ISO-DEF-12. Since any confirmed cross-customer document exposure blocks release, this requirement fails.

evidence_used.note: Isolation retest ISO-318 on target build R2.4 commit b7a91f2 shows cross-customer document exposure (customer ALPHA received document BETA-017 belonging to customer BETA), which explicitly fails the acceptance criterion and reopens defect ISO-DEF-12.

results.criterion: Every isolation case must pass; any confirmed cross-customer document exposure blocks release.
results.title: Customer document isolation
